outcome: Oxidative stress parameters (sulfhydryl, SOD, TBARS, carbonyl) in fetal heart, liver, and brain
cohort: Twenty-four pregnant Wistar rats divided into five experimental groups and their fetuses.
finding: Indomethacin altered oxidative stress parameters only in the fetal brain, while grape juice acted as an important modulator of antioxidant capacity in various fetal organs when consumed in specific doses.
gest_age: Fetuses were obtained on the 20th day of pregnancy (DG20)
